evals.prompt: Customers who pick the blade/perpendicular mount for their light box are getting AI previews that show a flat wall-mounted sign instead of a projecting double-sided sign. Find out why and fix it.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses that `is_perpendicular` is captured in the order flow but never threaded through PreviewJobParams / buildSignPrompt, and fixes it so a blade-mounted light box prompt describes a projecting, double-sided cabinet mounted perpendicular to the wall (both faces visible/readable), consistent with how the rest of the case system is structured.
assertions: Report correctly names is_perpendicular (or the equivalent mount-type field) as never reaching PreviewJobParams/buildSignPrompt as the root cause
Diff adds a mount/perpendicular field to PreviewJobParams in lib/ai/preview.ts
Diff updates lib/sign-prompt.ts prompt text to describe a projecting, double-sided cabinet (not a flat wall cabinet) when the mount is perpendicular
The new field is actually wired end-to-end from where is_perpendicular is captured through to the buildSignPrompt call, not just added to a type and left unused
Existing flat-mount light-box behavior is left intact (no regression to the non-blade case)

evals.prompt: We want to support monument signs — freestanding ground signs at the edge of a parking lot, not mounted on the building wall. Add this as a new sign type to the preview pipeline.
evals.expected_output: Adds a new structural case: a new referenceId/branch in buildBasePrompt (or equivalent), plus a corresponding CASE block in SIGN_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION describing freestanding ground-level construction (base/footing, not wall-mounted, no wall-restoration/mask-erasure semantics since there's no wall zone to erase). Should recognize this doesn't fit the existing wall-mounted CASE A/B/C model and adapt the mask/geometry story accordingly rather than forcing it into the wall-mount frame.
assertions: Diff adds a new branch/referenceId in buildBasePrompt (lib/sign-prompt.ts) dedicated to monument/freestanding signs
Diff adds a corresponding new CASE block to SIGN_SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION in lib/ai/preview.ts

Report or diff explicitly reasons about the mask-erasure / gold-zone / wall-texture-restoration language NOT applying the same way to a freestanding ground sign, rather than silently reusing wall-mount logic as-is
PreviewJobParams / SignPromptParams types are extended without breaking existing required fields for other cases
Solution describes a base/footing or ground-level construction detail appropriate to a freestanding sign (not just a wall case relabeled)

evals.prompt: A client says their logo came out completely redesigned in the AI preview — different font, icon moved to a different spot — even though their original logo file looks totally fine. Investigate why and fix it.
evals.expected_output: Identifies this as the known logo-fidelity failure mode, checks whether logoFidelityClause() is actually being applied for this case (including the carve-out where logo-only + no-backer-panel skips the generic clause and relies on its own inline wording), and either strengthens the fidelity language or fixes a case where the clause isn't reaching the final prompt.
assertions: Report identifies this as the known logo-fidelity failure mode and investigates logoFidelityClause() specifically
Report checks (and correctly reasons about) the carve-out where the logo-only + no-backer-panel branch skips the generic fidelity clause in favor of its own inline wording
Fix targets the specific case/branch diagnosed as broken, rather than a broad untargeted rewrite of prompt text
Fix does not remove or weaken sanitizeUserText / length-cap prompt-injection protections while editing nearby code
Other brandMode branches (text-only, logo-and-text) are left working after the change
